ratio.observations: Returned width1672 and height941 retained unchanged. This is permitted nearest-integer edge rounding, not a claim of mathematically exact 16:9 or maximum supported native dimensions.

style.checked_requirement: Natural-color photographic editorial scale comparison, modest serif identity, broad prose ledge and full-size two-part visit ledger.

evidence.observation: Wide hand/pot crop on left and tall plant/chair crop on right form unequal photographic scales; a prose-to-visit ledge follows the left crop and extends underneath the taller image.

Serif title is optically modest relative to photography. The slogan and three-line medium sans paragraph align above the market group. The adjoining access/care/invitation/URL group is useful reading space, not a tiny isolated footer.
A continuous forearm and cupped palm visibly support the pot base. Pot rim and soil connect to many stems and leaves; the small plant is scaled to a human hand.
The larger ficus has visible stems rooted in soil, a full ceramic pot base resting on the floor and a cropped chair with seat and legs establishing domestic scale.

excluded_template_check.observations: The two photographic distances and asymmetric crop lengths create the principal structure and the prose ledge. They are substantive current-content scale comparisons. The image is not an information board decorated with a tiny object or an empty room used to hold text.

evidence.observation: Title has clear mature serif construction and open inner spaces. Body Hangul has stable rectangular proportions, consistent stroke weight and readable counters; no broken or ambiguous Hangul syllable was observed.
Ordinary leading and clear word spaces preserve the paragraph's three-line continuity. Date, hours, place, access, care, invitation and URL are readable in their respective nearby groups.

evidence.location: Left start from slogan through paragraph to market
evidence.observation: The near photo leads to the bold slogan, then the complete explanation, then the same left-aligned market name/date/hours group across a small local gap.
Access and care begin beside the market group, followed directly by invitation and URL. Hours and venue share a baseline.
Pot base lies within the cupped palm; forearm joins wrist and the curled digits. Occluded fingers are not separately countable, but the supporting contact and limb continuity are visible.

evidence.location: Right pot base, floor and chair legs
evidence.observation: Pot floor contact and chair supports show coherent directional daylight and local shadows.

Both rectangular photo edges are crisp. Soil, leaves, pottery, sleeve weave and chair wood retain natural texture; no labels are printed on pots. Type is flat and high-contrast with no texture imposed across small glyphs.

located_observations.observation: Photos and serif identity provide first anchors; the bold slogan and left body maintain the next reading start, while both lower groups remain close to that ledge.
Access/care/invitation/URL are smaller than the broad paragraph but remain readable at the inspected720-wide size.

selection_reason: No observed copy omission, required-condition violation or material defect warrants a bounded repair. Retain the first native result with its clear scale comparison and complete readable content.
